exclusion_basis: dataset question id found in any earlier cache file name, whether or not that image was finally evaluated

selection.stage_1: accent-insensitive keyword match on Tesseract-only text (one of the product engines)
selection.stage_2: agent viewed every hit; all hits were solid-geometry problems and all were kept
selection.selection_bias: Images whose keywords Tesseract cannot read are under-represented, so recognition figures on this corpus may be optimistic.

miss_rate_audit.note: all 43 non-hits of rows 240-299 were viewed, then a seeded sample of the full non-hit pool (seed 20261112)
miss_rate_audit.sample_overlaps_first_batch: possible; the two views are not disjoint
solid_geometry_but_out_of_scope_in_first: row 257: count edges of a drawn polyhedron

exposure_of_evaluation_split: The agent that transcribed the images also runs the evaluation, so the split is developer-exposed, not blind. No product code may be tuned on it; any item used for a fix must be moved to development and reported.

independent_h1_candidate_pool.condition: listed by metadata only; images never downloaded or viewed by any agent in this run. Becomes H-1 only if an independent person selects, transcribes and scores them.

prior_corpora: The 12 older VMMU images and the 8 images of real-image-ocr-vision-comparative-acceptance are development-exposed and are not reused here.
